'''NT-X2''' or '''Entax''' and his counterpart [[BT-X2]] were designed as a top-of-the-line [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], however they were stolen mid-transport and ended up working for [[Luskin Exovar]] as [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]] at [[Exovar's Emporium]].

==Biography==
After being stolen, Entax and [[BT-X2|Botax]] were sold by a shipjacker to [[Luskin Exovar]] to pay off a debt. Luskin, who was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] lover at heart, tinkered with their programming and discovered that the two of them made an excellent security team.

Under the direction of [[Redeye (Turazza)|Redeye]], the [[Exovar's Emporium]]'s head of security, the pair kept order in the otherwise chaotic facility.

==Personality and traits==
Entax was philosophical and preferred to spend his downtime reading [[Holobook/Legends|holonovels]].

==Behind the scenes==
Entax was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].
